title: Verdant Courtyard Hotel
brief: A garden-led boutique hotel where shaded thresholds and tactile rooms turn arrival into a slow ritual.
overview: The hotel is organized around a series of planted courts that temper the tropical climate and create distinct moments of arrival. Public rooms remain visually connected while each retains its own atmosphere.
Locally inspired textures, woven details, and an earthy palette give the interiors a strong sense of place. The design prioritizes ease of maintenance without losing its crafted character.
